title: Deep learning based identification of bone scintigraphies containing metastatic bone disease foci.
summary: A deep-learning model detected metastatic bone-disease foci in bone scintigraphy and was evaluated on a 998-image external-center cohort.
ai_technology: training/validation and external test cohorts plus an in-silico clinical trial; Results report model performance and reader-relevant evaluation.
